options.content: **Ampliación del corpus (FA, 07-11-2026).** Tres conjuntos externos recorren F1–F3 con sus propios topics, sin alterar F3 (la foto antes y después de cada carga coincide). **APT29 day2**: validación de los patrones con otra jornada de ataque. **Zeek**: red de APT29; sus logs son de *otra ejecución* de la emulación (25–51 h antes y sin puertos en común), así que sirven para topología, no para confirmar aristas de P2. **COMISET v2**: actividad normal de una red universitaria (106 horas de 15 equipos, elegidas con el censo de los 202 M de registros) para medir falsas alarmas. Un equipo (`desktop-mh88805`) tenía **Atomic Red Team** ejecutando pruebas: se separa como `fa_art` y no cuenta como actividad normal. **08-11-2026: COMISET LAB** (`fa_lab`, un equipo de laboratorio: 85 alertas y 0 campañas) y el **laboratorio propio** de F2.3 (`fa_vm`: P1 en el ataque y nada en la línea base) validan el ajuste v2 sobre datos no vistos.

panels.title: Volumen y resultados por origen del dataset

targets.rawSql: SELECT v.origen, count() AS datasets, sum(e.eventos) AS eventos, sum(a.alertas) AS alertas, sum(c.campanas) AS campanas FROM (SELECT * FROM tfg.verdad_datasets FINAL) AS v LEFT JOIN (SELECT dataset_id, count() AS eventos FROM tfg.events FINAL GROUP BY dataset_id) AS e ON e.dataset_id = v.dataset_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT dataset_id, count() AS alertas FROM tfg.alerts FINAL GROUP BY dataset_id) AS a ON a.dataset_id = v.dataset_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT dataset_id, count() AS campanas FROM tfg.campaigns FINAL GROUP BY dataset_id) AS c ON c.dataset_id = v.dataset_id GROUP BY v.origen ORDER BY v.origen

SELECT v.dataset_id AS dataset, v.origen, v.verdad, count(e.time) AS eventos, min(e.time) AS desde, max(e.time) AS hasta, round(dateDiff('second', min(e.time), max(e.time)) / 3600, 3) AS horas_observadas FROM (SELECT * FROM tfg.verdad_datasets FINAL WHERE startsWith(origen, 'fa')) AS v LEFT JOIN (SELECT dataset_id, time FROM tfg.events FINAL WHERE dataset_id IN (SELECT dataset_id FROM tfg.verdad_datasets FINAL WHERE startsWith(origen, 'fa'))) AS e ON e.dataset_id = v.dataset_id GROUP BY dataset, v.origen, v.verdad ORDER BY dataset SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1
SELECT count() FROM tfg.alerts FINAL WHERE dataset_id IN (SELECT dataset_id FROM tfg.verdad_datasets FINAL WHERE origen = 'fa_benigno')

panels.title: Campañas en actividad normal

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() FROM tfg.campaigns FINAL WHERE dataset_id IN (SELECT dataset_id FROM tfg.verdad_datasets FINAL WHERE origen = 'fa_benigno')

panels.description: Toda campaña aquí es una falsa alarma.

panels.title: Alertas por host-hora observada

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT count() FROM tfg.alerts FINAL WHERE dataset_id IN (SELECT dataset_id FROM tfg.verdad_datasets FINAL WHERE origen = 'fa_benigno')) / (SELECT sum(h) FROM (SELECT dateDiff('second', min(time), max(time)) / 3600 AS h FROM tfg.events FINAL WHERE dataset_id IN (SELECT dataset_id FROM tfg.verdad_datasets FINAL WHERE origen = 'fa_benigno') GROUP BY dataset_id))

panels.description: Denominador: horas realmente observadas por host. Con el piloto (~6 min) no es representativo.

panels.title: Equipo con Atomic Red Team: alertas / campañas

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(toString((SELECT count() FROM tfg.alerts FINAL WHERE dataset_id IN (SELECT dataset_id FROM tfg.verdad_datasets FINAL WHERE origen = 'fa_art'))), ' / ', toString((SELECT count() FROM tfg.campaigns FINAL WHERE dataset_id IN (SELECT dataset_id FROM tfg.verdad_datasets FINAL WHERE origen = 'fa_art'))))

panels.description: desktop-mh88805, dentro de COMISET REAL, con Atomic Red Team ejecutando pruebas. El pipeline lo marca con campañas P1 y P3.

panels.title: Reglas que disparan sobre actividad normal

targets.rawSql: SELECT dataset_id AS dataset, rule_title AS regla, rule_level AS nivel, count() AS alertas, arrayStringConcat(groupUniqArray(5)(actor_process_name), ', ') AS procesos FROM tfg.alerts FINAL WHERE dataset_id IN (SELECT dataset_id FROM tfg.verdad_datasets FINAL WHERE origen = 'fa_benigno') GROUP BY dataset, regla, nivel ORDER BY alertas DESC

SELECT toString(dst_port) AS puerto, count() AS conexiones FROM tfg.events FINAL WHERE dataset_id IN (SELECT dataset_id FROM tfg.verdad_datasets FINAL WHERE origen = 'fa_red') AND dst_port IS NOT NULL GROUP BY puerto ORDER BY conexiones DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT dataset_id AS dataset, IPv6NumToString(src_ip) AS origen, IPv6NumToString(dst_ip) AS destino, dst_port AS puerto, class_name AS clase, count() AS registros FROM tfg.events FINAL WHERE dataset_id IN (SELECT dataset_id FROM tfg.verdad_datasets FINAL WHERE origen = 'fa_red') GROUP BY dataset, origen, destino, puerto, clase ORDER BY registros DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: Campañas de day2 (revisadas: 4 verdaderas, 1 falsa por wininit/csrss → LSASS)

targets.rawSql: SELECT pattern_id AS patron, first_seen AS inicio, arrayStringConcat(devices, ', ') AS hosts, arrayStringConcat(stages, ' → ') AS etapas, confidence_score AS confianza, arrayStringConcat(technique_ids, ', ') AS tecnicas FROM tfg.campaigns FINAL WHERE dataset_id = 'SDWIN-200502035409' ORDER BY inicio

panels.title: Ajuste v2 frente a v1, COMISET LAB y laboratorio propio
Campañas v1 (tfg.campaigns) frente a v2 (tfg.campaigns_v2) por origen

targets.rawSql: SELECT v.origen, countIf(c.version = 'v1') AS campanas_v1, countIf(c.version = 'v2') AS campanas_v2 FROM (SELECT dataset_id, 'v1' AS version FROM tfg.campaigns FINAL UNION ALL SELECT dataset_id, 'v2' AS version FROM tfg.campaigns_v2 FINAL) AS c INNER JOIN (SELECT dataset_id, origen FROM tfg.verdad_datasets FINAL) AS v ON v.dataset_id = c.dataset_id GROUP BY v.origen ORDER BY v.origen

panels.description: v1 son las cifras oficiales de F3; v2 es la versión actual desde el 08-11-2026 (validada en LAB y fa_vm).

panels.title: Laboratorio propio y COMISET LAB: alertas y campañas por dataset

targets.rawSql: SELECT v.dataset_id AS dataset, v.origen, v.verdad, a.alertas, a.altas, c.campanas, c.patrones FROM (SELECT * FROM tfg.verdad_datasets FINAL WHERE origen IN ('fa_vm', 'fa_lab')) AS v LEFT JOIN (SELECT dataset_id, count() AS alertas, countIf(rule_level IN ('high', 'critical')) AS altas FROM tfg.alerts FINAL GROUP BY dataset_id) AS a ON a.dataset_id = v.dataset_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT dataset_id, count() AS campanas, arrayStringConcat(groupUniqArray(pattern_id), ', ') AS patrones FROM tfg.campaigns FINAL GROUP BY dataset_id) AS c ON c.dataset_id = v.dataset_id ORDER BY v.origen DESC, dataset SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1
